title: Mímir dynamics catalog
description: Schema for the facilitator's dynamics catalog. The CONTENT lives in the deployment's private data volume (/data/catalog.json), never in this public repo — purchased/copyrighted material may enter the private catalog in full, but publishing it here would redistribute it. This file is the contract plus one rights-free sample.

category.description: The school's seven categories, from the facilitator's corpus.

purpose.description: 'Para qué': what happens to the group. One line.

reveals.description: 'Qué revela': what this shows about the group that was not visible before — the field that makes it facilitation, not a game.

curve.description: Where it belongs in the energy curve.

safety.description: Safety warning, attached to the name in every UI.

discardIf.description: Condición de descarte — when NOT to use it. May be '⚠️ sin fuente' if the corpus does not say.

tier.description: Quality scale. cantera = ingested with metadata only; destacada = proposed by Mímir (ficha completeness + fit with the school's depth ladder); validada = confirmed by the facilitator. The final criterion is always human.

dominio.description: The facilitator's own relationship to it. 'usada' outweighs 'leida'.

source.description: School, book, collection, or 'propia'. Cite the concrete collection.

steps.description: Full steps. OMIT for copyrighted material in any public context — point to `stepsRef` instead.

stepsRef.description: Where the steps live when they cannot be copied (e.g. a vault path or the original publication).

dynamics.name: Check-in de ronda
dynamics.purpose: Que cada voz entre una vez antes de trabajar.
dynamics.reveals: Quién llega cargado y qué trae el grupo hoy.
